name: PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk
summary: PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a property developer in Indonesia. The company develops commercial products, including shophouses; and residential landed houses. It also processes fishery products services. The company was formerly known as PT Pratama Abadi Nusa Industri Tbk and changed its name to PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk in July 2023. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Jakarta Utara, Indonesia. PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Multi Artha Pratama.
